Metadata.title: Puertas Cifuentes · Made-to-measure quotes
Metadata.description: Configure your made-to-measure door and get a quote in minutes.

Home.title: Puertas Cifuentes · Made-to-measure quotes
Home.intro: Configure your made-to-measure door in minutes: choose a series, measurements, finish and accessories, and see the price live.

scope.configurator: Public configurator with 2D preview and live price
scope.tariffs: Versioned tariffs by validity period and maximum size per series
scope.quote: Quote as PDF and email, multilingual
scope.admin: Admin panel for the catalogue and prices

Home.footer: Hexagonal architecture and SOLID · Next.js + PostgreSQL · Vercel
